mapper.select: select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, a.`status` signUpStatus from corgi_activity_attender a left join corgi_user_position p on a.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where a.activity_id = #{activityId}
